choices.choice: Short arm up-left from the bottom point, much longer arm up-right (classic tick).
choices.authority: specialist choice implementing the owner asymmetrical-arms requirement
choices.reason: The conventional, most recognisable completion tick in left-to-right UIs. The asymmetric-check-mark criterion requires only visibly asymmetrical arms (length and/or angle) and does not fix ratio or orientation, so a mirrored, differently proportioned or equal-length/unequal-angle asymmetric tick still passes. Accepted by caller review f0ab7290... as a prompt choice, not a rejection rule.

choices.choice: Chunky ~2px strokes, centered, no backing circle/badge plate, no drop shadow.
choices.reason: Chunky strokes survive 1x at 16x16 and keep the arm-length difference legible; no plate keeps transparency simple and leaves room for family marks. Revisable at style review; not rejection rules.
